title: Irish Cheese Ploughmans Lunch
description: A traditional Irish ploughman's lunch featuring cheese, bread, and pickles, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Kooky bread
ingredients.notes: A crusty bread, suitable for making sandwiches

ingredients.name: Northern Irish butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter for spreading on bread

instructions: 1. Slice the Ploughmans cheese into thin wedges.
2. Butter two slices of Kooky bread.
3. Place two slices of bread on a clean surface, followed by a slice of cheese, a few pickle slices, and a sprig of parsley.
4. Place the remaining two slices of bread on top to create a sandwich.
5. Cut the sandwich in half, diagonally or horizontally, as desired.
7. If desired, serve with additional pickle slices on the side.
8. Repeat the process to create additional sandwiches as needed.
9. Consider serving with a side salad or fruit for a more substantial meal.
10. Leftover cheese and pickle slices can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
